project_comments.note: Cross-cutting observation: the only non-trivial risk across all WPs is the OWASP A01 path-traversal issue in nodes.py (subfolder + filename inputs). 0 Critical/High security findings. 23/23 tests passed. 0 rework cycles. Synthesis recommends a targeted remediation plan as the sole priority for the next development cycle.

outcome_summary: Implemented a production-ready ComfyUI V3 custom node (SaveTextNode) that saves user-supplied text to a file in the ComfyUI output directory, delivered across 4 work packages with 18 pipeline stages, 23 passing tests, and zero rework cycles. The node is zero-dependency, V3-API-only, and packaged correctly per the ComfyUI custom node reference pattern. Two Medium OWASP A01 path-traversal risks were identified in the subfolder and filename inputs — documented in README and api-surface.md but intentionally deferred as non-blocking; remediation is the primary recommendation for the next plan cycle.
